label: Graded-foundation controls, checked (inference)
rule: Explicit finite interpretations, checked by case analysis and accessibility induction
meaning: Controls for the graded batch. The joint witness shows all new premises (the two restricted no-ascent premises follow there from the global one by actualAscentWFOfGlobal and necessaryAscentWFOfGlobal), the reused grade premises and the cause principle are jointly satisfiable with a nonempty grounding edge, grade and cause, so no derivation is vacuous on that ground. The descending grade shows that well-founded grounding and a well-founded grade do not give ascent: the ascent premise is a substantive addition. Off-world ascent shows that the rigid ascent premises with no infinite ascent imply neither coverage nor the one-way no-novel-edge condition (the converse, from no-novel-edge to ascent of the fixed MoreIn esse, is not certified). The rival controls show the rotating triangle and rooted pair admit no rigid well-founded grade ascended by necessary support, while the rooted pair still satisfies the join's endpoint. Model-witnessed only; no interpretation is claimed metaphysically possible.
